added: English Country Dance figures: when you edit a dance whose form is English, the figure picker now offers its own figures, such as set, turn single (including cloverleaf), cast, lead, siding, back-to-back, the heys for three, four and six, contra corners, petronella, pull by, and poussette, pushed or drawn. Who dances can name several groups at once ("twos and threes"), and a figure you pick leaves unstated anything you don't fill in. Typing English figures as text still reads them as contra figures for now.
Advanced search can find dances by English figures too; where an English figure shares a contra figure's name, the picker labels it with its form, such as "circle · English (ECD)".
Add ecdTaxonomy (ecdTaxonomyVersion 1): ADR-006 §7's 52 movements under ecd_ IDs and the ecd_swat_the_flea alias, registered in shippedTaxonomies. Add ecdSelectors and ecdDestinations.
Add ParamKind.dancerList (a list of dancer tokens, ECD's who), ParamVocab.soloDancerTokens and isValidDancerList.

FigureRenderer renders a dancerList as an English list and expands ECD templates with ADR-006 §6.3's optional groups and flags; a sequence ending in an ECD star back to place reads "and back by the left".
Add ecdSequenceSpanIssue and stepStatesTiming: an ECD sequence may carry one span for untimed steps (ADR-006 §5.5).
Add ecdTaxonomyCanonicalRebuildDoneKey, a one-time canonical/FTS rebuild listed in oneTimeRepairMarkers.
testFigure and the fixture-validity ratchet validate against shippedTaxonomies.anyForm, and the ratchet reads list literals.
canonicalizeMoveSearchText lets the taxonomy's own form win a name or keyword another form also uses, so searching every form reads contra's keywords as before.
figureSnippetSignature keys an ECD template's {?flag} and a dancerList (sorted, joined by +); migrateFigureSnippetSignature leaves ecd_ keys unchanged.
